newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian foreign minister to visit Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Colombian foreign minister to visit Belgium.

text.p: Colombian Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia will pay a two-day visit to Belgium from Thursday for talks on human rights and efforts to combat drug trafficking, a ministry statement said.

The statement said she would meet her Belgian counterpart, Erik Derycke, and Minister of Finance and Foreign Trade Philippe Maystadt to "primarily discuss matters relating to human rights and to the fight our country is waging against drug trafficking."
Mejia would also meet Jose Maria Gil-Robles, president of the European Parliament, and Manuel Marin, vice president of the European Commission, among other officials in Belgium, the statement added.
